text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, the first report in this channel was your own message at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: gate kiosks offline at Hartford, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard in the meantime.

Other points from the channel:
- 10:44: Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate.
- 11:03: Mateo said kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see.
- 11:07: you noted both lanes were working.

One earlier entry exists. SUP-5380 (Hartford gate kiosks offline, Sev 1) has an update logged at 08:12 saying the reboot failed and drivers were queueing. The log doesn't show who wrote it, so check the ticket if you need the first report.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: Ruth, Gideon's 11:08 AM message in this channel on 3 Aug says the status-page screenshot is attached to ticket **INC-4821**. I haven't opened the ticket itself, so I can't confirm the attachment from the file.
